data.gender_notes: Job is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Job is derived from the Hebrew word ‘Iyov’, which means ‘perfect’ or ‘blameless’. In the biblical story, Job is a righteous man who is tested by God. Despite his suffering, he maintains his faith and is ultimately rewarded. The name Job carries the meaning “Perfect, blameless” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Job usually hope their child will grow to embody perfect, blameless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unwavering faith and resilience in the face of adversity.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Job total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
